purpose: Prototype prompts for testing NyayaSetu scheme retrieval and optional geo-spatial channel routing.
data_notice: All channel partners in channel_partners.csv are synthetic mock records and must not be presented as real branches.

conversation_prompts.input: I am an SC entrepreneur from Delhi with an annual family income of 3 lakh rupees. I need a 1 lakh loan to start a small tailoring business.
conversation_prompts.expected_channel_flow: Return scheme recommendations immediately, then ask whether the user wants nearby channel partners.

conversation_prompts.input: I am an SC farmer in Uttar Pradesh with family income below 5 lakh rupees. I need a 20 lakh term loan for an agricultural project.
conversation_prompts.expected_channel_flow: Recommend the term loan without requiring location first.

conversation_prompts.input: I am an SC student from West Bengal and need an educational loan of 12 lakh rupees for a professional course.
conversation_prompts.expected_channel_flow: Return education-loan guidance first; nearby channels are optional.
conversation_prompts.location_follow_up: B B D Bagh, Kolkata, West Bengal

conversation_prompts.input: I am a woman SC entrepreneur in Tamil Nadu with an annual family income of 2 lakh rupees. I need 1 lakh rupees for a home-based food business.
conversation_prompts.expected_mock_partner: MOCK Chennai RRB Women Enterprise Desk

conversation_prompts.input: I am an SC beneficiary with income under 5 lakh rupees and I need help choosing between a micro finance loan and a term loan.
conversation_prompts.expected_channel_flow: Return scheme recommendations and say: If you want to know your nearby channel partners, enter your location address.

conversation_prompts.input: I need a business loan and I live near Pune, Maharashtra.
conversation_prompts.expected_channel_flow: Do not return MOCK Pune Disqualified High NPA Branch because its NPA rate is 8.2 percent.
conversation_prompts.excluded_mock_partner: MOCK Pune Disqualified High NPA Branch

conversation_prompts.input: I need an SC business loan in Jharkhand.
conversation_prompts.expected_channel_flow: Do not return MOCK Ranchi Exhausted Fund Branch because available funds are zero.

voice_prompts: Please tell me what scheme or financial support you need. I can recommend schemes now. If you want nearby channel partners, you can say your location afterward.
If you want to know your nearby channel partners, say your complete village, district, and state address.
I could not locate that address. Please say a more complete address, including district and state.
